title: Camera Behaviour inheritance
summary: Camera Behaviour supplies the precedent for learned-world generations, materialized immutable snapshots, source barriers and cautious behavioural evidence.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Live model mutation must not mutate a historical snapshot.
A genuine source discontinuity must not silently inherit incompatible learned nuisance/scene state.
procedure: Map Camera learned generations to MLLearnedGeneration.
Keep camera-specific behaviour semantics in Camera, not ML Core.
